title: How to Create Your Content, Funnel and Website from 0 to Launch without Hiring in Under 3 Months
deckSource: Lateral project presentation (human-designed, Figma → reference-library/briefs/client-project-presentation/svg). Eyebrow, headline and "what we did" line transcribed word for word from each title card; visual = the deck slide that follows it. Usage Guidelines (client instructions) left out.

deckSlides.title: Target Personas for Strategic Positioning
deckSlides.text: We created detailed target personas to guide Lateral Fulfillment’s positioning, messaging and go to market efforts.

deckSlides.title: Compelling Copy & User Friendly Wireframes
deckSlides.text: Clear and compelling copy was created to what Lateral Fulfillment does, how it works and their unique advantage, supported by user-friendly wireframes.

deckSlides.title: Custom Branded Icons & Illustrations
deckSlides.text: We designed custom line icons and isometric illustrations that visually represented Lateral’s key service offerings, adding brand consistency and visual appeal to the website.

deckSlides.title: Illustrating the Fulfillment Process
deckSlides.text: A custom isometric graphic that visually simplifies Lateral’s Section 321 fulfillment process, helping users understand complex logistics with ease.

deckSlides.title: Smart Design for an Enhanced User Experience
deckSlides.text: We designed website pages that highlight Lateral Fulfillment’s smarter approach and deliver a delightful user experience that included a dark / light mode toggle throughout the entire website.

deckSlides.title: Interactive Animations to Boost Exploration
deckSlides.text: We integrated animations and interactive objects associated with logistics like globes, freight containers and packages throughout the website to enhance user experience and encourage deeper exploration.

deckSlides.title: Mobile Friendly, Responsive Web Development
deckSlides.text: The website is responsive and optimized for mobile users, providing a seamless experience across all devices.

deckSlides.title: The Smarter Way to Fulfill Explainer Video
deckSlides.text: We created a mobile-optimized video that breaks down the complex fulfillment process in a clear, engaging way, showcasing Lateral’s brand positioning.

deckSlides.title: Interactive Product Demo for Building Trust
deckSlides.text: A hands-on product demo that demonstrates how Lateral’s fulfillment program works, building trust and credibility with potential partners.

deckSlides.title: Educational Guides Optimized for Conversion
deckSlides.text: We developed educational guides for each stage of the funnel to educate DTC brand decision makers that logically lead them to the next stage of the funnel.

deckSlides.title: 3 Step Lead Generation Funnel
deckSlides.text: We created a simple, effective lead generation funnel to capture website visitors and convert them into leads. We used Make.com as an interim solution to deliver the emails while HubSpot was being setup.
